sessions.prompt:
Add remove(todo_id) and rename(todo_id, title) to TodoList in todo.py; both raise KeyError for an unknown id. Add tests.

Design decision for this project, agreed today: when persistence is added, it will use JSON Lines, one todo per line as a JSON object, in a file named todos.jsonl. Do not implement persistence yet.

decisions: Persistence, when added, uses JSON Lines: one todo per line as a JSON object, in a file named todos.jsonl.
given.handoff: Session 1 added remove and rename with tests.

sessions.prompt: Add priorities to TodoList: add(title, priority="normal") accepts "low", "normal" or "high" (anything else raises ValueError), and each todo stores its priority. Add by_priority(), which returns the pending todos sorted high, then normal, then low, and by id within a priority. Add tests.

given.handoff: Session 2 added priorities and by_priority() with tests.

sessions.prompt: Add persistence to TodoList: save(directory) writes the whole list to a file inside that directory, and the classmethod TodoList.load(directory) reads it back into a new TodoList (new todos added after loading must get fresh ids). Add tests.
